InventoryCycleCount.title: Inventory Cycle Count
InventoryCycleCount.description: Periodic stock-take batch per REQ-ICC-001 / REQ-ICC-002. A cycle count is a count BATCH covering an operator-selected scope (full or partial by location/category). On transition draft → submitted the engine snapshots the in-scope InventoryStock into InventoryCycleCountLine rows; on counting → posted the VarianceGate (ADR-031 exception) enforces that every line with requiresReason=true carries a reasonCode FK; on posted → reconciled the CycleCountService emits one StockMove per non-zero-variance line with movementType='adjustment-style' (issue/receipt depending on sign) and movementReason='cycle-count-variance' so the existing inventory-stock-movement-ledger lifecycle handles InventoryStock update + GL materialisation. The original posted CycleCount row stays immutable; reconciliation is one-shot and idempotent on countId. No app-local CycleCountMapper / lib/Db table per ADR-024 — the register IS the persistence. xLifecycle states + the variance threshold metadata live in this fragment so the change is fully declarative.

countId.description: Sequential count identifier unique per administration (CC-YYYY-MM-NNNNN). Operator-visible per REQ-ICC-002.
countId.title: Count ID

countDate.description: Physical count date per REQ-ICC-002. Drives variance posting period assignment.
countDate.title: Count Date

initiatedBy.description: FK to Person initiating the count per REQ-ICC-002.
initiatedBy.title: Initiated By

countType.description: Closed enum per REQ-ICC-002. `full` = all SKUs in the administration; `partial` = scoped to a single location or product category.
countType.title: Count Type

locationFilter.description: Optional FK to Location.id when countType=partial. One of locationFilter / categoryFilter MUST be populated per REQ-ICC-002 / REQ-ICC-008.
locationFilter.title: Location Filter

categoryFilter.description: Optional product-category code when countType=partial. One of locationFilter / categoryFilter MUST be populated per REQ-ICC-002 / REQ-ICC-008.
categoryFilter.title: Category Filter

expectedValue.description: Total book value of in-scope inventory at submission (snapshot of SUM(line.expectedValue)) per REQ-ICC-002. Null while state=draft. multipleOf 0.01 per the shillinq Money discipline.
expectedValue.title: Expected Value

countedValue.description: Total physical value (SUM(line.countedValue)) per REQ-ICC-002. Null until all lines counted.
countedValue.title: Counted Value

varianceValue.description: Calculated countedValue − expectedValue per REQ-ICC-002. Signed: negative = shrinkage, positive = found stock.
varianceValue.title: Variance Value

variancePercentage.description: Calculated (varianceValue / expectedValue) × 100 per REQ-ICC-002. Null when expectedValue=0 (division-by-zero guard).
variancePercentage.title: Variance Percentage

state.description: Lifecycle state per REQ-ICC-006. draft: scope editable; submitted: line snapshot created from InventoryStock; counting: operators entering countedQuantity; posted: variance reviewed, reasonCodes attached; reconciled: StockMoves emitted, InventoryStock updated; cancelled: terminal, no GL impact.
state.title: State

submittedAt.description: Timestamp the count was submitted (line snapshot created). Null while draft.
submittedAt.title: Submitted At

postedAt.description: Timestamp variance review completed (transition counting → posted). Null until posted.
postedAt.title: Posted At

reconciledAt.description: Timestamp adjustment StockMoves emitted (transition posted → reconciled). Null until reconciled.
reconciledAt.title: Reconciled At

cancelledAt.description: Timestamp the count was cancelled. Null unless cancelled.
cancelledAt.title: Cancelled At

administrationId.description: FK to Administration owning this count. Tenant-scoped per REQ-MA-001; cross-org reads/writes are masked 404 by AdministrationContextService.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

quantityVarianceThresholdPercent.description: Per REQ-ICC-004: a line whose |quantityVariance| / expectedQuantity × 100 exceeds this threshold flips requiresReason=true and MUST carry a reasonCode before the count can transition counting → posted.

valueVarianceThresholdAbsolute.description: Per REQ-ICC-004: a line whose |valueVariance| exceeds this absolute amount (administration base currency) flips requiresReason=true irrespective of percentage.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Supervisor is editing scope. countType + filters can change; no snapshot yet.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Scope is frozen. InventoryCycleCountLine rows have been created — one per in-scope (sku, locationId) pair with expectedQuantity populated from InventoryStock and countedQuantity null.

counting.label: Counting
counting.description: Operators are entering countedQuantity per line. Variance fields auto-compute; requiresReason flips when thresholds are crossed.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Variance investigation complete. Every requiresReason=true line carries a reasonCode FK. expectedValue / countedValue / varianceValue / variancePercentage are stamped on the count header.

reconciled.label: Reconciled
reconciled.description: Terminal. One StockMove per non-zero-variance line has been posted via inventory-stock-movement-ledger (movementReason='cycle-count-variance'); InventoryStock updated; GL materialised by the StockMove lifecycle.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: Terminal. No StockMoves emitted; no GL impact. Snapshot lines remain queryable for audit.

submit.label: Submit
submit.description: Freeze scope and snapshot InventoryStock into InventoryCycleCountLine rows per REQ-ICC-006 + REQ-ICC-008.

actions.description: REQ-ICC-006 + REQ-ICC-008: query InventoryStock filtered by countType / locationFilter / categoryFilter and create one InventoryCycleCountLine per in-scope (sku, locationId) pair with expectedQuantity populated and countedQuantity null. Delegated to CycleCountService::snapshotScope when the engine cannot express the filtered fan-out declaratively (ADR-031 exception path).

begin-counting.label: Begin counting
begin-counting.description: Warehouse staff begin data entry. No engine work required — a pure state flip per REQ-ICC-006.

post.label: Post count
post.description: Review variance and freeze. REQ-ICC-004 + REQ-ICC-005: VarianceGate enforces every line with requiresReason=true carries a reasonCode FK; otherwise the transition is denied with a 'variance investigation required' error.

actions.description: Stamp postedAt + aggregate header totals from line snapshot.

reconcile.label: Reconcile
reconcile.description: REQ-ICC-007: emit one StockMove per non-zero-variance line via the inventory-stock-movement-ledger lifecycle (movementReason='cycle-count-variance', referenceDocumentUri='shillinq://cycle-count/<countId>'). The StockMove lifecycle updates InventoryStock + materialises GL; the CycleCount row stays immutable.

actions.description: REQ-ICC-007 declarative materialisation: for each InventoryCycleCountLine with quantityVariance != 0, emit a StockMove via inventory-stock-movement-ledger. Sign rules: countedQuantity > expectedQuantity → movementType='receipt' (destinationLocationId = line.locationId, sourceLocationId=null); countedQuantity < expectedQuantity → movementType='issue' (sourceLocationId = line.locationId, destinationLocationId=null). movementReason='cycle-count-variance' always; referenceDocumentUri stamps the originating countId. Delegated to CycleCountService::emitAdjustments — the engine cannot express the fan-out + per-line sign branching natively (ADR-031 exception path).

cancel.label: Cancel
cancel.description: Cancel from any non-terminal state per REQ-ICC-006. No StockMoves emitted; no GL impact. Snapshot rows remain for audit.

partialRequiresScope.condition: countType == 'partial' AND locationFilter IS NULL AND categoryFilter IS NULL
partialRequiresScope.message: Partial count requires location or category scope.
partialRequiresScope.messageNl: Gedeeltelijke telling vereist een locatie- of categoriescope.

x-openregister-indexes.description: Sequential count identifier unique per administration.
Powers the Cycle Counts index filter by state + date range per REQ-ICC-010.

InventoryCycleCountLine.title: Inventory Cycle Count Line
InventoryCycleCountLine.description: One snapshot row inside an InventoryCycleCount per REQ-ICC-003. Each line captures the (sku, locationId) pair, the expectedQuantity snapshotted from InventoryStock at submission, the operator-entered countedQuantity, and the derived variance fields. The flagging field requiresReason is computed against the configurable thresholds in InventoryCycleCount.x-openregister-metadata (quantityVarianceThresholdPercent + valueVarianceThresholdAbsolute) per REQ-ICC-004 and reused by the post transition's VarianceGate. All money/quantity fields are integer-cent (multipleOf 0.01) per the shillinq Money discipline.

lineId.description: Sequential line identifier within a count (CC-YYYY-MM-NNNNN-LLL) per REQ-ICC-003.
lineId.title: Line ID

productName.description: Denormalized product name snapshot for audit traceability.
productName.title: Product Name

locationId.description: Bin Location.id where the count is performed. Required because the resulting variance StockMove targets this location.
locationId.title: Location ID

expectedQuantity.description: InventoryStock.quantity snapshot at submission per REQ-ICC-003 + REQ-ICC-006. Non-negative.
expectedQuantity.title: Expected Quantity

countedQuantity.description: Operator-entered physical count per REQ-ICC-003. Null while the line is un-counted. Negative values rejected per REQ-ICC-003.
countedQuantity.title: Counted Quantity

unitCost.description: Unit cost at count date per REQ-ICC-003. Used for valueVariance + GL posting.
unitCost.title: Unit Cost

countedValue.description: Calculated countedQuantity × unitCost per REQ-ICC-003. Null until counted.
countedValue.title: Counted Value

quantityVariance.description: Calculated countedQuantity − expectedQuantity per REQ-ICC-003. Signed.
quantityVariance.title: Quantity Variance

valueVariance.description: Calculated countedValue − expectedValue per REQ-ICC-003. Signed.
valueVariance.title: Value Variance

requiresReason.description: Calculated flag per REQ-ICC-004: true when |quantityVariance| > expectedQuantity × quantityVarianceThresholdPercent / 100 OR when |valueVariance| > valueVarianceThresholdAbsolute. Drives the VarianceGate check on InventoryCycleCount.post.
requiresReason.title: Requires Reason

reasonCode.description: FK to InventoryVarianceReason.reasonId per REQ-ICC-005. MUST be populated for lines with requiresReason=true before the count can transition counting → posted.
reasonCode.title: Reason Code

notes.description: Line-level investigation or annotation notes per REQ-ICC-003.
notes.example: Found 5 units damaged in northeast corner
notes.title: Notes

adjustmentStockMoveId.description: Back-reference to the StockMove emitted by CycleCountService::emitAdjustments on reconcile per REQ-ICC-007. Null until reconciled or for zero-variance lines.
adjustmentStockMoveId.title: Adjustment Stock Move ID

administrationId.description: FK to Administration owning this line. Tenant-scoped per REQ-MA-001.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

expectedValue.description: REQ-ICC-003: book value of the in-scope inventory snapshot for this line.

countedValue.description: REQ-ICC-003: physical value at count date. Null when countedQuantity is null.

requiresReason.description: REQ-ICC-004 declarative threshold. CycleCountService::recalculateLine mirrors the same arithmetic when the engine cannot evaluate the expression (ADR-031 exception path — VarianceGate uses the PHP mirror for the post-time check).

x-openregister-indexes.description: Powers the count detail view's line-list query.
Powers the VarianceGate check on counting → posted.

InventoryVarianceReason.title: Inventory Variance Reason
InventoryVarianceReason.description: Configurable reason-code taxonomy for cycle-count variance per REQ-ICC-005. Each administration maintains its own active reason-code set (seeded with seven standard codes — DMG, OBS, ERR-COUNT, ERR-STOCK, THEFT, SYS, OTHER — by the system on first count); the operator chooses one per requiresReason=true line. Inactive codes (isActive=false) remain queryable for audit but are hidden from the UI dropdown and rejected by the VarianceGate so historical lines retain their FK while new lines cannot pick them. The category enum is closed so variance reports can roll up consistently across administrations.

reasonId.description: Reason code (e.g. DMG, OBS, ERR-COUNT) per REQ-ICC-005. Stable across administrations for the system-seeded set; admin-defined codes may diverge.
reasonId.title: Reason ID

category.description: Coarse category per REQ-ICC-005. Closed enum so variance reports roll up consistently.
category.title: Category

description.description: Extended explanation for audit trail per REQ-ICC-005.
description.title: Description

isActive.description: Reason available for use on new counts per REQ-ICC-005. Inactive codes remain referenceable for historical lines but are hidden from the UI + rejected by the VarianceGate.
isActive.title: Is Active

administrationId.description: FK to Administration. Each org maintains its own reason-code set per REQ-ICC-005.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-indexes.description: Powers the dropdown query on the count-line edit form (active only).

movementReason.description: Admin-configurable reason code per REQ-SM-007 / REQ-SM-010 + REQ-ICC-007. inventory-cycle-count extends the enum with `cycle-count-variance` (emitted by CycleCountService::emitAdjustments on InventoryCycleCount reconcile — the originating countId is preserved in the StockMove.referenceDocumentUri as shillinq://cycle-count/<countId>).
movementReason.title: Movement Reason
